name: CJC-1295
description: Lab-made GHRH analogue (29 amino acids) with an added group that binds blood albumin

note.text: Human studies measured growth hormone and IGF-1. Sleep was not measured.

bullets: **Albumin binding** makes it last much longer than natural GHRH
**Acts on the pituitary,** like GHRH, to release growth hormone
**In healthy adults,** one injection raised GH for 6 days or more
Two small dose trials in healthy adults
Phase II trial terminated, no results posted

practical.pharmacokinetics: Binds albumin; IGF-1 above baseline up to 28 days with repeat doses
practical.soldAs: Not approved; not on FDA compounding bulks lists
practical.monitored: Growth hormone, IGF-1, drug levels, safety (trials)

regulatory.text: Not in the Oct 2026 peptide policy

references: J Clin Endocrinol Metab, Teichman et al., CJC-1295 in healthy adults, Mar 2006
FDA, bulk drug substances that may present significant safety risks (Category 2), Apr 2026
